description: Example registry for the audio-algo control platform. Target repos: lxrobertxiong-beep/robert_music (algo+control) and lxrobertxiong-beep/audio-algo-eval (eval). License Apache-2.0+DCO. filter-listen local_path is algo/filter-listen. call-nr local_path is the in-repo relative path algo/call-nr. Do not invent metrics or claim admission results.

license.notes: Self-authored skeleton: Apache-2.0 + DCO. Optional RNNoise, DeepFilterNet, GTCRN, and Silero VAD pins keep their upstream licenses and are not vendored. Weights stay on a local path. Not an eval-admission claim.

pins.name: RNNoise
pins.notes: Not vendored. Build upstream yourself. Not an eval-admission claim.

pins.name: DeepFilterNet3
pins.notes: Optional extra. Not an eval-admission claim.

pins.name: GTCRN
pins.notes: No upstream release tag. Weights are not vendored. Not an eval-admission claim.

pins.name: Silero VAD
pins.notes: v6.2.x line: 8 commits after tag v6.2.3, not the tag itself. JIT is not vendored. Not an eval-admission claim.

entrypoints.name: setup_pins
entrypoints.args_hint: (prints pin metadata; does not download weights)

entrypoints.name: smoke_missing_weights
entrypoints.args_hint: (asserts exit 3 when gtcrn/silero pins or torch are absent; does not download weights)

eval_adapter.notes: Restricted eval repo lxrobertxiong-beep/audio-algo-eval. Not vendored in this public repo. Admission thresholds unset; do not claim pass or board results. Algorithm code lives at algo/call-nr.

license.notes: Self-authored Apache-2.0 + DCO. AutoEq optional MIT pip dep (do not vendor whole tree); openMHA reference-only (no AGPL vendoring). No Jieli binaries. In-repo at algo/filter-listen; entrypoint paths are relative to local_path.

entrypoints.name: generate_peq_from_fr
entrypoints.args_hint: --fr <fr.csv> [--target harman_like] [--no-autoeq] -o <peq.json> (control-plane export_peq defaults --no-autoeq; AutoEq is optional and not vendored)

entrypoints.name: export_metrics
entrypoints.args_hint: --wav <wav> --peq <json> -o <metrics.json> (fr_rmse_db only when --fr is passed; fixture stub, not an admission claim)

entrypoints.name: run_demo
entrypoints.args_hint: [--fr testdata/synthetic_fr.csv] [--out <dir>] (stdlib; always --no-autoeq; fixture fr_rmse_db is not an admission claim)

plugins.notes: peq_schema gain stays required on every band. lowpass and highpass ignore gain: RBJ cookbook passband gain is 0 dB (see peq.py). Not an admission claim.
